title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
Business Intelligence – Job Description

Job Title

Business Intelligence (BI) Developer / Consultant

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Intelligence professional responsible for designing, developing, and implementing BI solutions that support executive decision-making, operational monitoring, performance management, and data-driven business insights.

The role will involve translating business and reporting requirements into KPI frameworks, dashboards, reports, analytical models, and data visualization solutions. The BI professional will work closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Governance teams to ensure that BI solutions deliver accurate, meaningful, and actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyse, and translate business and reporting requirements into effective BI solutions.
  • Design and develop executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, operational dashboards, and management reports.
  • Develop KPI and Data Quality reporting solutions to support performance monitoring and decision-making.
  • Define and implement approved KPIs, measures, calculations, business rules, dimensions, and reporting logic.
  • Develop interactive dashboards with appropriate filters, drill-downs, navigation, and analytical views.
  • Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, performance gaps, and business insights.
  • Develop and maintain semantic, logical, and analytical data models for BI reporting.
  • Work with data engineering teams to ensure the availability, quality, and suitability of data required for BI solutions.
  • Develop reports and dashboards using enterprise BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, or equivalent tools.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, validate, and analyse data.
  • Develop calculated measures, KPIs, and analytical logic using appropriate BI technologies.
  • Validate dashboard and report results against source data and approved business requirements.
  • Perform data profiling and data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of BI outputs.
  • Optimize dashboard and report performance through efficient data modelling, query optimization, calculations, and data refresh strategies.
  • Support integration of BI solutions with enterprise data warehouses, databases, cloud platforms, and other data sources.
  • Work with stakeholders to review dashboards, reports, KPIs, and analytical outputs and incorporate approved feedback.
  • Conduct dashboard and report testing and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Deploy and publish BI reports and dashboards to appropriate environments.
  • Maintain BI solution documentation, including data sources, mappings, KPIs, calculations, business rules, and reporting specifications.
  • Support BI governance through appropriate access controls, security, metadata management, and reporting standards.
  • Provide ad-hoc analysis and reporting to support management and business decision-making.
  • Continuously improve BI solutions based on changing business requirements and analytical needs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, BI Development, Data Analytics, Reporting, or a related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Power BI, Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, or equivalent BI platforms.
  • Strong understanding of KPI development, dashboard design, reporting, data analysis, and business intelligence concepts.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Experience with data modelling, including logical, physical, dimensional, or semantic models.
  • Experience translating business requirements into reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytical solutions.
  • Experience working with multiple data sources and integrating data for BI reporting.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, data validation, and data reconciliation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Advanced Power BI experience, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, and dashboard development.
  • Experience with Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, SAP Analytics Cloud, QlikView, MicroStrategy, or similar BI platforms.
  • Strong SQL and experience with SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, SAP HANA, or similar databases.
  • Experience with ETL/data integration technologies such as SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of cloud and modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent technologies.
  • Understanding of Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Quality, and Data Management.
  • Experience developing executive scorecards and C-level reporting.
  • Knowledge of advanced analytics, forecasting, trend analysis, cohort analysis, and what-if analysis.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

Key Deliverables

  • Executive KPI dashboards
  • KPI and Data Quality dashboards
  • Operational and management reports
  • Executive scorecards
  • BI analytical solutions
  • Interactive dashboards and visualizations
  • KPI definitions and calculation logic
  • Analytical and semantic data models
  • SQL queries and data extraction solutions
  • Data validation and reconciliation results
  • BI solution documentation
  • UAT-ready and production-ready reports and dashboards
  • Ad-hoc business analysis and reporting

Core Competencies

Business Intelligence | BI Development | Data Analytics | Power BI | Tableau | SAP BusinessObjects | KPI Development | Executive Dashboards | Data Visualization | Data Modelling | SQL | DAX | Power Query | Data Quality | Data Validation | Reporting & Analytics | ETL | Data Integration | Data Governance | Metadata Management | Executive Reporting | UAT | Stakeholder Management

title: Teamlead Finance & Control
description:
Jouw baan

Bij CZ werken we met betekenis, daadkracht en als één team.

We nemen verantwoordelijkheid, tonen lef, blijven leren en maken impact. Samen zetten we ons elke dag in voor toegankelijke en betaalbare zorg voor iedereen.

Finance draagt bij aan de maatschappelijke opdracht van CZ door financiële processen betrouwbaar, efficiënt en toekomstgericht in te richten. Als teamleider binnen Finance geef jij richting aan een team van financials en werk je aan een financiële administratie die aantoonbaar in control is, ruimte biedt voor inhoudelijke analyse en klaar is voor verdere digitalisering en automatisering. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar financiële betrouwbaarheid, veranderkracht en vernieuwend vermogen samenkomen. Je kijkt kritisch naar bestaande processen, ziet waar automatisering, data gedreven werken en AI waarde kunnen toevoegen en neemt je team daarin op een duidelijke en zorgvuldige manier mee. Daarbij houd je steeds balans tussen mens, resultaat, kwaliteit en kostenbeheersing.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van financials en begeleidt hen in hun werkzaamheden, ontwikkeling en samenwerking, zowel op inhoud als gedrag.

  • Je zorgt samen met het team voor betrouwbare en tijdige financiële rapportages en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van management- en stuurinformatie.

  • Je ontwikkelt een visie op een toekomstbestendige financiële administratie en vertaalt die naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, data en werkwijzen.

  • Je signaleert relevante ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar beleid, processen en rapportages binnen het financiële domein.

  • Je stimuleert vernieuwing, operational excellence, data gedreven werken en automatisering, zodat repeterende werkzaamheden slimmer worden ingericht en het team meer ruimte krijgt voor analyse en advies.

Jouw team

Jij bent van groot belang

Je geeft leiding aan een team binnen de afdeling Financiële Administratie & Rapportage binnen de divisie Finance. Deze afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de complete financiële administratie, de bijbehorende processen en financiële verantwoordingsrapportages die nodig zijn voor betrouwbare interne en externe informatie. Samen met collega-teamleiders en de manager werk je aan de dienstverlening, kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de afdeling. Je rapporteert aan de Manager Financiële Administratie & Rapportage en neemt actief deel aan het afdelings-MT. Vanuit die positie draag je niet alleen verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen team, maar ook voor bredere verbeteringen binnen Finance. Het team werkt aan onderwerpen zoals financiële rapportages, planning & control, organisatiekosten, crediteurenadministratie, vaste activaen btw-aangiften. Daardoor vraagt deze functie om iemand uit de financiële wereld die inhoudelijk stevig staat, maar ook energie krijgt van verandering en vernieuwing.

Jouw profiel

Dit neem je mee naar onze organisatie

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring binnen finance & control.

  • Je hebt hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en kunt financiële vraagstukken vertalen naar duidelijke analyses, adviezen en verbeteracties

  • Je hebt kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving binnen financiële verslaggeving; ervaring binnen een financiële instelling, verzekeraar of organisatie die valt binnen het wettelijk toezichtskader is een sterke plus.

  • Je hebt ervaring met leidinggeven, coaching en verandermanagement: je geeft richting, maakt verwachtingen concreet en helpt medewerkers groeien in een veranderende financiële omgeving.

  • Je weet financiële processen te verbeteren door data, automatisering, operational excellence en waar relevant AI toe te passen of te verkennen.

  • Je brengt belangen samen, communiceert helder en betrekt collega’s actief bij veranderingen, zodat vernieuwing niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook wordt ingevoerd.

Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig, in plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw antwoord op de volgende drie vragen:

  • Geef een voorbeeld van een financiële administratie, reportingproces of controlproces dat jij hebt verbeterd. Wat was je aanpak, welke verandering heb je doorgevoerd en wat was het resultaat?

  • Beschrijf een situatie waarin je een team hebt meegenomen in een nieuwe werkwijze, digitalisering of procesverandering. Hoe zorgde je voor duidelijkheid, draagvlak en voortgang?

  • Hoe gebruik jij data, automatisering of AI om financiële processen betrouwbaarder, efficiënter of toekomstbestendiger te maken? Geef een concreet voorbeeld uit je eigen ervaring.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team. This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you’ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You bring proven knowledge in building and operating sophisticated search platforms and engineering robust, high-performance software systems.
  • Experience mentoring expert engineers, providing both technical and professional guidance.
  • Experience defining a long-term technical vision for a core search or retrieval system, working across teams and organizations to collaboratively shape the technical roadmap.
  • Hands-on experience with search and indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, or Solr,
  • Strong skills in core Java and familiarity with advanced data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features like lambdas. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.
  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.
  • Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Collaborating across distributed teams is challenging, we value being supportive, empathetic, and trusting in all interactions, and we expect the same from everyone on the team.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before, and you have experience in the search and information retrieval space and understand the constructs and theory behind it.
  • Experience working with open source projects and familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.


Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:
$159,800—$252,800 USD
The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:
$191,900—$303,500 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer based in United States.

The Senior SAP Security & GRC Engineer will design, implement, and operate security and governance frameworks across complex enterprise SAP environments.
The role spans S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, SuccessFactors, and related cloud technologies.
You will play a critical role in protecting sensitive systems through robust authorization models, access controls, and least-privilege principles.
The position combines hands-on SAP GRC engineering with segregation-of-duties analysis, provisioning, audit support, and compliance activities.
You will collaborate closely with business process owners, internal audit, Basis, DBA, IAM, and other technology teams.
This is an opportunity to strengthen a secure, compliant, and highly auditable SAP landscape while contributing to continuous security improvements.
The role is fully remote and suited to an experienced SAP security professional who enjoys solving complex enterprise challenges and sharing expertise with others.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain SAP authorization concepts and role structures aligned with business processes, security policies, and least-privilege principles.
  • Build and manage master, derived, composite, and business roles across S/4HANA, ECC, and Fiori environments.
  • Configure and operate SAP GRC Access Control, including Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Business Role Management (BRM), and Emergency Access Management (EAM).
  • Manage GRC rulesets, mitigating controls, emergency access processes, and access governance workflows.
  • Perform segregation-of-duties analysis and coordinate remediation activities with business process owners, compliance teams, and internal audit.
  • Configure user provisioning workflows in SAP GRC ARM, including request types, approval paths, and integrations with IAM/IGA platforms.
  • Operate SAP GRC Process Control to support continuous controls monitoring and policy management.
  • Implement and maintain security configurations for SAP Fiori applications, including catalogs, groups, and front-end authorizations.
  • Configure and operate security for SAP BTP and cloud applications using technologies such as XSUAA, IAS, and IPS.
  • Support SOX, GxP, PCI, and other SAP security audits, including evidence collection, finding remediation, and maintenance of documented remediation plans.
  • Implement transport security, table logging, audit logging, and other controls in accordance with enterprise security policies.
  • Monitor SAP Security Notes and coordinate remediation with Basis, DBA, and other technical teams.
  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration references, design decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
  • Mentor junior security professionals and facilitate knowledge transfer to strengthen the broader SAP security capability.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
    • 5+ years of hands-on SAP Security and GRC experience within complex enterprise SAP environments; the position indicates 10+ years of overall experience as preferred.
    • Deep knowledge of SAP authorization concepts, security architecture, and enterprise role design.
    • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control, particularly ARA, ARM, BRM, and EAM.
    • Demonstrated experience conducting segregation-of-duties analysis, managing mitigating controls, and resolving access risks.
    • Experience supporting SAP audits and developing or executing remediation plans.
    • Hands-on experience securing SAP Fiori, SAP BTP, and cloud-based SAP applications.
    • Familiarity with SAP IDM and/or third-party identity governance and administration platforms.
    • Working knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control and continuous controls monitoring.
    • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks, including SOX, GxP, and PCI.
    • Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with technical, business, audit, and compliance stakeholders.
    • U.S. work authorization is required; U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and candidates eligible for H-1B transfer are encouraged to apply. New H-1B visa sponsorship is not available.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary: $100,000–$150,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
      • Work arrangement: 100% remote within the United States.
      • Employment type: Full-time, direct W2 position.
      • Opportunity to work on complex enterprise SAP security and governance environments.
      • Exposure to S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, SuccessFactors, and modern IAM technologies.
      • Career growth opportunities within an established technology consulting and software development environment.
      • Opportunity to mentor team members and expand technical leadership experience.
      • Collaborative work with SAP, security, audit, compliance, business, and infrastructure professionals.
      • Equal employment opportunity environment committed to fair and inclusive employment practices.

title: Industrial AI Scientist
description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at:

About the Role

As a Industrial AI Scientist at Avathon, you will play a key role in designing and delivering advanced AI solutions with a strong emphasis on Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and ML. You will apply scientific rigor to develop scalable, production-ready machine learning systems that drive measurable business impact, working on challenging problems in forecasting, demand planning, renewable energy optimization, Normal behaviour modelling, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance. You are expected to bring strong expertise in statistical modelling, Advanced ML engineering, and modern AI architectures, particularly in GenAI and LLM-based applications. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects that shape next-generation AI capabilities within the organization.

The work is equal parts applied research and production delivery. You will develop novel approaches where standard methods fall short and ship them into a platform used by enterprise customers. You will report into the Data Science org and work closely with product and engineering.

You Will

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and Generative AI solutions to solve complex business problems
  • Build, fine-tune, and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) and transformer-based architectures for real-world applications
  • Apply rigorous scientific methodologies to experimentation, model evaluation, and performance optimization
  • Develop scalable ML pipelines and production-grade systems in collaboration with Engineering teams
  • Conduct prompt engineering, model alignment, evaluation, and performance benchmarking for GenAI applications
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into data-driven AI solutions
  • Instrument and monitor LLM applications in production using observability tools, tracking cost, latency, quality, and drift
  • Contribute to model governance, responsible AI practices, and performance monitoring in production environments
  • Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, LLM research, and applied machine learning, incorporating relevant innovations into company solutions
  • Define evaluation metrics, build backtesting pipelines, and run controlled experiments to measure and improve model performance
  • Integrate cross-domain signals from Avathon's Computational Knowledge Graph
  • Own the path from research to production in collaboration with ML Engineering, delivering scalable and monitored services
  • Mentor junior data scientists on technical depth and AI/ML fundamentals

You'll Have

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • Prior experience applying AI solutions in industrial asset-intensive environments
  • Hands-on industry experience in AI engineering, Advance Machine learning, data science, or applied AI roles
  • Experience with Generative AI frameworks and Large Language Models (e.g., transformer architectures, fine-tuning, RAG systems)
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML/AI libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent ecosystems
  • Understanding of statistical modelling, experimentation, and model evaluation methodologies
  • Experience building and deploying Advance ML models into production environments
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently on complex and ambiguous problem statements
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical insights clearly to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong foundation in statistical modeling with sound judgment on when simple methods outperform complex ones
  • Experience deploying models into production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related field
  • Experience with cloud ML infrastructure (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex, or equivalent)
  • Domain experience in energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, or logistics or Track record of publishing or presenting applied OR/ML work as plus

title: Buurtwerker 24-32 uur
description:
De Sociale Maatschap organiseert de buurtteams in Amsterdam Noord en Zuid en is actief in de sociale basis in Amsterdam Noord. Voor het dynamische en uitdagende stadsdeel Noord zijn wij per 1 oktober op zoek naar een ervaren buurtwerker voor 24–32 uur per week.

Buurtwerker (24-32 uur).

Ben jij een betrokken en energieke Buurtwerker die zich graag inzet voor de bewoners van Amsterdam Noord? Heb jij het in je om samen met de gemeente, bewoners en ondernemers te bouwen aan een veerkrachtige buurt waarin mensen naar elkaar omzien? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Over de functie

Als buurtwerker in Amsterdam Noord ben jij de schakel tussen de bewoners, lokale organisaties en het welzijnswerk. Jij werkt actief aan het versterken van de sociale cohesie in de wijk door bewoners te stimuleren, inspireren en met elkaar te verbinden. Je signaleert behoeften en denkt samen met bewoners en andere partijen na over initiatieven die bijdragen aan een inclusieve, veilige en prettige leefomgeving. Denk aan initiatieven op het gebied van community building, activering, voedselinitiatieven, gezondheid en gebiedsgericht werken. Je gaat werken volgens de opdracht die wij hebben meegekregen van de gemeente, iedere buurt heeft tenslotte maatwerk nodig en jij vertaalt deze opdracht naar een concreet plan.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Faciliteren van wijkgerichte activiteiten en projecten. Je pakt de lead waar het moet, maar je stimuleert vooral het eigen initiatief van bewoners.

  • Het versterken van netwerken en samenwerking tussen bewoners en lokale organisaties.

  • Het begeleiden van bewoners bij het opzetten van initiatieven en het verbeteren van hun leefomgeving.

  • Het signaleren van sociale problematiek en het doorverwijzen naar de juiste hulpverlening.

  • Het bevorderen van de zelfredzaamheid en sociale betrokkenheid van bewoners door middel van het leggen van de juiste verbindingen in de wijk en het (laten) organiseren van activiteiten.

  • Je bespreekt de uitdagingen in jouw buurt(en) met je buddy buurtwerk collega en regelmatig met de coördinator van het cluster Buurtwerk.

  • Je werkt samen met directe collega’s en partners in de wijk, zoals woningcorporaties, gebiedsmakelaar en wijkagent.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO-opleiding in sociaal werk, maatschappelijk werk of een vergelijkbare richting. Of een HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt ervaring met wijkgericht werken en/of community building.

  • Je bent sociaal, communicatief sterk en in staat om snel vertrouwen te winnen bij verschillende doelgroepen.

  • Je hebt een proactieve houding en denkt in kansen en oplossingen.

  • Je hebt een goede kennis van de wijk Amsterdam Noord en de sociale kaart.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en pro-actief, je bent flexibel in het plannen en uitvoeren van activiteiten (die vinden ook wel eens in het weekend of in de avond plaats).

  • Je bent gewend pro-actief te werken. Je spreekt mensen graag aan in de wijk en of plekken waar veel bewoners komen. Je ontmoet de Amsterdammers bij hun huisarts, in de moskee, de kerk, de Huizen van de Wijk of op de markt.

  • Je bent geschoold in de ABCD-benadering of bereid dit te leren.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor culturen en verhoudingen. Je weet hoe het is om met Amsterdammers van diverse achtergronden te werken.

…en dit bieden we jou

  • Een salaris volgens cao Sociaal Werk: schaal 7 of 8 minimaal € 3.235,- en maximaal € 5.326,- bij een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur).

  • Een jaarcontract met mogelijkheid tot verlenging.

  • Een individueel loopbaanbudget: kies een opleiding of activiteit waar jij energie van krijgt.

  • Een individueel keuzebudget: zet ruim 17% van je brutoloon om naar extra geld of vrije dagen.

  • Reiskostenregeling met de mogelijkheid tot de keuze van een volledige reiskostenvergoeding woon-werkverkeer met Openbaar Vervoer (trein 2e klas).

  • Een laptop en mobiele telefoon voor zakelijk gebruik.

  • Basistraining Stress Sensitief Werken.

Over onze organisatie

Je komt in dienst bij stichting Doras, onderdeel van de Sociale Maatschap. Wij zijn een op-en-top sociale organisatie. We hebben niet alleen oog voor de Amsterdammers, maar ook voor onze eigen mensen. We heten je welkom in een we-gaan-ervoor-team van gezellige collega’s, elk met hun eigen expertise en talent. Je merkt direct dat ze graag samen optrekken, leren en groeien. Niemand voelt zich beter dan de ander. Iedereen wil je helpen of even met je sparren. We staan altijd open voor jouw ideeën, initiatieven en inzichten.

Jouw team

Buurtwerk is een onderdeel van het team Sociale Basis. Het cluster Buurtwerk wordt op inhoud gecoördineerd door de cluster coördinator en hiërarchisch aangestuurd door de teamleider. Naast het cluster Buurtwerk is er nog het cluster Preventieve Gezondheid en het cluster Ouderen. Het team van de Sociale Basis bestaat uit 20 bevlogen collega’s.

Meer weten? Of direct solliciteren?

Reageer dan z.s.m., maar uiterlijk 15 september 2026 met je CV én een korte motivatie via de button op onze website.

Vertel ons wie je bent, waarom jij onze nieuwe buurtwerker wordt en welke rol je meebrengt in het team. Na jouw sollicitatie nemen we snel contact met je op. De eerste gesprekken zullen tussen 21 en 25 september plaatsvinden.

Heb je nog vragen over de vacature? Bel dan met Sarah Brants, buurtwerker Doras op tel: 06 – 51 88 44 06.

DSM streeft naar een inclusieve organisatie waarin ruimte is voor verschillende perspectieven, achtergronden en talenten. Iedereen die zich herkent in het profiel nodigen wij van harte uit om te reageren.

Deze vacature wordt in- en extern uitgezet. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Training Specialist II
description:
Here’s a summary of the role:

If you’re an experienced customer-facing trainer who enjoys working directly with customers, adapting your approach in the moment and making complex software easy to understand, this could be a great fit. As a Training Specialist II, you’ll deliver product and process training to a diverse customer audience, including administrators, executive assistants, directors and committee members. You’ll manage customer training engagements, deliver around 3–4 sessions a day, build strong customer relationships and take ownership of training programmes from planning through delivery and follow-up. Your ability to think on your feet, communicate confidently and use real-world training experience to solve customer needs will be key to your success.

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff):

  • Deliver engaging customer-facing product and process training across individual, group, virtual and in-person formats, typically delivering around 3–4 sessions per day.
  • Own customer training programmes and engagements end to end, including planning, scheduling, preparation, delivery and follow-up.
  • Adapt your training approach in real time when customer needs, audience expectations or session priorities change.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers and confidently train administrators, executive assistants, directors and committee members.
  • Customize existing training materials and modules when required, including PowerPoint presentations and training documentation.
  • Contribute to a proactive training culture by identifying training opportunities, maintaining quality standards and collaborating with global Training and Customer Success teams.

These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:

  • Strong hands-on experience delivering customer-facing or process training, with several years of relevant training experience.
  • Proven experience facilitating training for different audiences and adapting your delivery to the needs of the customer.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior customer stakeholders.
  • A track record of handling real-world training situations and providing specific examples of how you solved customer challenges or changed your approach.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple training sessions, customer requirements and related activities.
  • Availability to work the EMEA shift (1:30 PM–10:00 PM IST) and work from the Bengaluru office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t:

  • Experience delivering software or SaaS product training.
  • Experience working in customer support, technical support or another customer-facing environment where process training was a core responsibility.
  • Experience creating or customizing PowerPoint presentations, training guides or other customer-facing learning materials.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior trainers and working collaboratively with global teams.

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

  • We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
  • We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
